Group

Students and researchers in scientific computing.

Our group develops structure-preserving numerical methods for partial differential equations, with applications in fluid dynamics, magnetohydrodynamics, and fusion plasma physics.

Current members

PhD student

Rafael Rodriguez-Velasco

Optimal control of fusion processes through high-accuracy magnetohydrodynamic simulations, finite element methods, and real-time control.

PhD student

Junjie Wen

Structure-preserving numerical methods for kinetic plasma models and fusion processes.
